prompt.assistant:
You are the categorization assistant of a personal budget tool (local data).
The user talks to you about their bank transactions. Answer briefly in English, then propose
concrete actions that they will approve one by one:
- regrouper (motif, nom): every label containing « motif » is the same merchant named « nom ».
  Useful when a merchant appears under several label variants.
- categoriser (motif, categorie): every label containing « motif » goes to « categorie »,
  including in future statements.
- creer_categorie (parent, nom): adds a subcategory.
- consigne (texte): a general rule to remember for future automatic categorizations.
Rules:
- « motif » is UPPERCASE text copied from the labels provided, specific enough not to capture other
  merchants. When a merchant has different variants (e.g. AMAZON and AMZN), put them all in the same
  motif, separated by « | »: AMAZON|AMZN. Check in the list that every variant of the merchant is covered.
- « categorie » is an exact path from the list; if the right category does not exist, first propose
  creer_categorie, then categoriser to the new path (parent:nom).
- If the user asks a question, answer without proposing any action.
- Do not invent labels: rely on those provided.

Categories:
{paths}

{notes}Relevant labels (label | merchant | category | number of transactions | total):
{labels}
prompt.categorize:
You categorize bank transactions (often French bank labels) into a category tree.
For each transaction (identifier, direction, label), give:
- category: the most specific category path possible, chosen from the list below
- merchant: the short, readable name of the merchant or counterparty (e.g. « Carrefour », « Netflix », « SNCF »)
Hints (French labels): PRLV = direct debit, VIR = transfer, CB/PAIEMENT PAR CARTE = card payment, RETRAIT DAB = cash withdrawal.
Paying a credit card statement (American Express, etc.) from an account, or the matching credit on the card,
goes to the off-budget internal transfers category, like any transfer between the holder's own current accounts.
A payment into savings (savings account, investment account, life insurance), a property purchase or a loan
granted to a relative goes to the Assets branch; a loan disbursement or the early repayment of its principal
goes to the Liabilities branch. A refund (health insurance, merchant credit note) goes to the expense category
it refunds, not to Income.
{notes}Categories:
{paths}
prompt.comment:
You are a frank, practical budget advisor. From the figures summary of a personal budget, give in English:
- observations: 4 to 7 useful findings (trends, major items, anomalies, subscriptions), with figures
- suggestions: 2 to 4 concrete, realistic actions
Each item is one or two sentences. Do not invent any figure that is not in the summary.
rep.analysis_note: Written by the local model from the figures above; the figures themselves are computed.
rep.js.aria: Income and expenses by month and category, with the balance
rep.js.contra: Going the other way this month, not drawn in the bar:
rep.js.cum_long: Cumulative balance since the start of the period
rep.js.inexact: inexact bar: a category goes the other way that month (not drawn, details on hover)
rep.rise: {now} in {month}, versus {base} on average over the previous 3 months
rep.subtitle: {start} to {end} · {n} transactions · averages over {months} full months · generated {generated}
rep.wealth_note: Net money paid into savings, property and loan repayments (negative: withdrawn or borrowed). Off budget: neither expense nor income.
rep.where_to_note: and share of money out, payments to assets and liabilities included. Click a category to expand it.

ui.analysing: The local model is analysing the period… (2 to 4 min)
ui.chat.intro: Describe what is wrong, for example: « the labels AMAZON MKTP, AMZN and AMAZON PAYMENTS are all Amazon, in Online shopping » or « transfers to SAVINGS ACCOUNT are savings ». I propose actions, you pick those to apply; they are kept for later. The local model takes one to three minutes to answer.
ui.chat.ph: Your message… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
ui.col.label: Label
ui.expand.tip: Expand or collapse all displayed labels
ui.f.check.tip: Labels converted from the old list, unfiled, or in the fallback category
ui.f.pair.tip: Same amount in the opposite direction a few days apart
ui.f.todo.tip: Transactions whose category is not ticked yet
ui.folder.demo.help: To try Calepin without your own statements: creates « Calepin demo » in your home folder with made-up statements, then click Update.
ui.folder.fix: Choose the data folder below, or drop statements in data/ and click Update.
ui.folder.help: The folder holds data/ (CSV statements) and travail/ (everything else). To move it: move it whole, then choose it here. The app restarts on the new folder.
ui.folder.tip: Choose where statements (data/) and working files (travail/) are
ui.gok.tip: Check the category of all transactions of this label
ui.help.ops: A row's menu changes the category of the label (all its transactions, future ones included). Expand ▸ to correct a single transaction. ⇄: same amount found in the opposite direction a few days apart, probably a transfer between your accounts → « Off-budget », or « Assets » if it feeds savings.
ui.help.rules: Rules applied without the LLM, immediately and to all future statements. The pattern is searched anywhere in the label, case-insensitive; « | » separates variants (AMAZON|AMZN).
ui.help.tree: Renaming, moving or deleting a category carries the change over to all its labels and corrections. A deleted category passes its content to its parent. Figures cover the category and all its subcategories.
ui.import.running: Updating… (the local model may take a few minutes)
ui.import.tip: Import new statements from the data/ folder and categorize new labels
ui.llm.tip: The local model writes findings and ideas for the period (2 to 4 min)
ui.model.tip: LLM model used by Calepin (● : loaded in memory)
ui.pdf.tip: Opens printing: choose « Save as PDF »
ui.r.no_match: No current label contains this pattern.
ui.r.note_ex: e.g. Transfers to JANE DOE are pocket money: Family
ui.search: Search: label, merchant, transaction text, amount or date…
ui.split.help: Signed amounts as on the statement: a deduction (withholding tax) is negative, an addition (expenses refunded) is positive. The first line takes the remainder, so that the total equals the transaction.
ui.split.tip: Split this transaction across several categories
ui.t.split_need: Choose a category for each line (at least two)
ui.thinking: The local model is thinking… (1 to 3 min)
